programme.title: Across the Ice
programme.desc: After 45+ expeditions throughout over 150+ countries, one of the world's leading adventurers and visionaries of conservation, Swedish explorer Johan Ernst Nilson dawns upon his biggest adventure yet. Follow his journey across the planet from the North Pole to the South Pole in Pole2Pole. The 525 day mostly carbon-neutral trek covers 20,000 miles by means of skis, dogsled, boat, bike and kite. Pole2Pole is not only one of the most difficult adventures hes ever attempted, but also one of his most philanthropic adventures. Johan visits charities along the way to share their stories and raise global awareness.

programme.title: The Wake
programme.desc: A Scottish fisherman struggles to keep his craft alive in the face of ecological destruction from industrial-scale trawling.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: In the rugged mountains of western Montana, a team of researchers makes a chilling discovery: the golden eagles they study are dying from a mysterious illness.

programme.title: Seb's Surf Therapy
programme.desc: Seb is a charismatic 12-year-old with ADHD and autism who embarks on a six-week surf therapy course.

programme.title: Chasing Bliss
programme.desc: Water is life, and the great conductor that connects us all. The oceans cover over 70% of our planet and hold almost 97% of the earth's water. True bliss in constant movement giving life around the globe. This is a story of an eclectic mix of people across Hawaii, Ecuador and the USA, who draw energy from this life force and channel it positively into their everyday lives. Join Paulino in understanding what drives Surfer Laid Hamilton, or filmmaker Robert Greaves, Big-Wave World Champion Paige Alms and Windsurfing World Record Holder Sarah Hauser. Coffee Farmer Anti Clancy, Dr Greg Mitchell, Research Scientist & Algae Visionary at Scripps.

programme.title: I Am Capable
programme.desc: After experiencing injustice when hiking in the English countryside, Amira Patel decided she wanted to help create a safe space for Muslim women outdoors.

programme.title: Return of the Rhino
programme.desc: In 2021, after a thirty year absence, black rhino were reintroduced to the wilds of Gonarezhou National Park in Zimbabwe. This is a story about hope, truth and the claiming of a much needed foothold for the critically endangered black rhino species.

programme.title: SLAY

programme.title: A Space in Time

programme.title: Dance for Change
programme.desc: An inspiring celebration of the Dance Crews of Dzaleka Refugee camp, who are transforming their community through creative expression.

programme.title: Lowest to Highest: One Foot in Front of the Other
programme.desc: A story of overcoming personal hurdles, resilience, connection, and how adversity can strengthen communities and individuals.

programme.title: Connected Off the Grid
programme.desc: Connected Off the Grid follows the stories of three unique off-grid lifestyles from the ocean, the desert, and the redwood forest to inspire us to stay connected to the earth and their communities.

programme.title: Against the Grain
programme.desc: The story of one of the most extensive permaculture experiments in the UK.

programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined the properties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with David Gross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

programme.title: Consciousness of Culture
programme.desc: Bruce Parry highlights the moments of his life that formed his career and life passion to champion indigenous cultures around the world through exploration and film. Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: The Nature of All Things
programme.desc: What is it that makes things what they are? Where does it come from? For Professor Seyyed Hossein Nasr, the quest for knowledge, specifically knowledge which enables man to understand the true nature of things and which furthermore, liberates and delivers him from the fetters and limitations of earthly existence, has been (and continues to be) the central concern and determinant of how we understand and live our lives.

programme.title: Cosmopsychism
programme.desc: This episode of Curious Minds with Yujin Nagasawa discusses the unique idea of cosmopsychism; an idea which argues our personal conscious experiences are segments of a larger consciousness that belongs to the cosmos. Yujin Nagasawas life work lies in the mystery of consciousness, existence and the philosophy of religion. This controversial conversation with Deepak Chopra uncovers new theories and explanations for consciousness, as they strive to uncover truth.

programme.title: Consciousness & Healing
programme.desc: Dr. Shamini Jain conducts clinical research in the areas of psychoneuroimmunology and integrative medicine, receiving several awards from scientific organizations for her work. Shes been continuously interested in the process of healing and strived to uncover many of the doubts she had in undergraduate school when she discovered the field psychoneuroimmunology; the integrated relationship between mind, brain and body.

programme.title: Book Of Knowledge
programme.desc: Traveling the world 30+ years, David Verdesi finds himself back in Rome. Urged to uncover the reason behind the instinctive human desire for spiritual yearning, Verdesi starts retracing the intersection of science and theology within the city his family has called home since the early 1400s. Vibrating from the walls of the citys sacred spaces, he discovers findings of oral history, predating the beginning of humanity by thousands of years. Documents and rare rituals that upend conventional ideas of the behaviors of the mind in ancient times. Narratives heavily influenced by civilizations and cultures beyond Rome, continue to influence the moral compass of life today, Verdesi realizes he is back on the road. Book of Knowledge The Quest for Meaning rediscovers and preserves the knowledge of our human potential and natures wisdom. This movie addresses questions around the intersection of science, spirituality, and anthropology. Join David Verdesi to the roots of the Book of Knowledge.

He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: Astrology Zone
programme.desc: Susan Miller is the founder and astrologist for AstrologyZone.com. The trusted, twenty-year-old platform provides the latest in intelligent astrological trends. This discussion with Deepak Chopra breaks down many popular misconceptions about astrological predictions, the various disciplines of study, ego, and consciousness in relation to astrology. Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting the most out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not the outcomethat outcome is completely up to you. I can give you questions to ask to help you decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.

programme.title: Modern Metaphysical Idealism
programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modern renaissance of metaphysical idealism. His theoretical reflections on the mind explain consciousness as the only element of life that allows us to understand reality, and everything we know about reality is subject to our experiences. This idea is often refuted by the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided by consciousness.

programme.title: Nature, Space and Matter
programme.desc: Our understanding of the nature of time, space and matter have changedeven what we mean by these termsin just the last few decades. Our interpretations continue to change and more theories form as we learn and study these topics. Dr. Fred Alan Wolf explains the origins of many of these foundational theories that have formed at different times and why they came about. Before quantum physics, people knew that human beings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with new revelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Creation Is Constant
programme.desc: Duane Elgin wants to show that the universe is a living field of existence, and that we are always in communion with a field of aliveness whether we are conscious of it or not. Throughout this lecture, Elgin explains his belief that in a living system, each part is integral to the whole, so each entity is intimately connected to the entire universe. To him, creation is not something that happened with the Big Bang. Instead, creation is consistently forming around us from a deeper abyss. The universes existence is brought moment by moment through this continuous, moving process.

programme.title: Consciousness & Healing
programme.desc: Dr. Shamini Jain conducts clinical research in the areas of psychoneuroimmunology and integrative medicine, receiving several awards from scientific organizations for her work. Shes been continuously interested in the process of healing and strived to uncover many of the doubts she had in undergraduate school when she discovered the field psychoneuroimmunology; the integrated relationship between mind, brain and body.

programme.title: Borderline Consciousness
programme.desc: Berit Brogaard was the first researcher to show that consciousness comes in degrees and that there can be borderline cases of consciousness. Her areas of research include perception, consciousness, emotions, philosophical psychology, semantics and philosophical logic. She also researches synesthesia, savant syndrome, blind sight, and perceptual reports.

programme.title: The Knobe Effect
programme.desc: We have experiences, creativity, understanding, thoughts, feelings and desires but do we know how these occurrences happen? Joshua Knobes research has been concerned with the impact of people's moral judgments on their intuitions about this question. He believes strongly that people's intuitions about whether a particular entity is conscious, essentially depends on whether the entity has the right sort of body. Therefore, he believes embodiment shapes our view of what is reality.

programme.title: Quantifying Beauty
programme.desc: How do we scientifically quantify beauty in people and in nature? How does the world embody beautiful ideas? Dr. Frank Wilczeks conversation with Deepak Chopra discusses his book, A Beautiful Question which tests the common misconceptions about how we form our opinions on success, beauty and our imaginations.

programme.title: Connections Between Science & Philosophy
programme.desc: Dr. Menas Kafatos is internationally known for bridging the disciplines, writing and lecturing extensively on the convergence between science and philosophy, as there is an inherent need for a dialogue between science, spirituality, and religion. His book, Creating Cosmos with Deepak Chopra discusses the melding of topics like inflation, environmental issues, natural hazards, quantum theory and consciousness.

programme.title: Iranian Space Pioneer
programme.desc: Iranian electrical engineer, entrepreneur and former astronaut, Anousheh Ansari was the first female private space explorer to fly to the International Space Station. She explains the challenging journey and the determination needed to reach space after immigrating to the U.S. from Iran. She also became the first person to publish a blog from space. The content invited readers to share her experience with the world. She described the Russian Soyuz capsule during liftoff, talked about the sights and smells of the space station, and explained the intricacies of everyday activities.

programme.title: Philosopher of the Mind
programme.desc: Dr. Paavo Pylkknens eclectic approach combines new physics-based insights with those of analytical philosophy, phenomenology, cognitive science and neuroscience. He proposes a view in which the mechanistic framework of classical physics and neuroscience is complemented by a more holistic approach. Pylkknen is particularly known for his work on mind-body-studies, building on David Bohm's interpretation of quantum mechanics.

programme.title: Evolution of Ideas
programme.desc: Everything we can know about our lives and the universe is a subjective experience, either formed by one's own perceptions or the reports of others. Dr. Bernardo Kastrup explains how we commonly associate this understanding about the universe as something separate of our consciousness, however he strongly believes otherwise; Kastrup believes the evolution of ideas we perceive about the universe are actually originating within us.

programme.desc: Are you ready for some electricyfing weather videos? Because we've got it all...wind storms, flashfloods, and even hurricanes! We've pulled together some of the craziest weather you've ever seen!

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | My Trashcan is Gone with the Wind
programme.desc: Get ready, because it's time once again to watch some of the wildest weather videos you've ever seen! From thunderstorms to tornadoes, hail to flooding, we've got it all

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | Throwing Porta Potties to the Wind
programme.desc: The world is a dangerous place, and with wild weather occurances happening every 20 seconds, it's no wonder we never have a shortage of footage to showcase here. The videos we have gathered are guarenteed to blow you away, so let's not waste anymore time and jump right into it.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | Oh Hail No
programme.desc: What's windy, wild, and wet all over? The weather, of course!

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | The Final Countdown
programme.desc: When bad weather strikes, most people head in doors, but we head right into the heart of it.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | Slip and Mudslide
programme.desc: Rain. Snow. Lightning. Hurricanes. Dust devils. When these weather phenomena combine, it's usually a recipe for disaster. But on this show, it's just another normal day in the books. It's time for Extreme Weather Countdown!

programme.title: Fight to Survive
programme.desc: Follow hunter Jamey Mosch into the Florida everglades as his hunting trips turns into a four day nightmare.

programme.title: Fight to Survive
programme.sub-title: Fight To Survive | Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E07 - High Water
programme.desc: Chris und Kaid, die seit mehreren Tagen im Zelt feststecken, bekommen endlich eine Pause, als sich das Wetter bessert. Sie erkennen, dass der Regen den Fluss auf gefährliche Pegel steigen ließ. Dennoch setzen sie ihre Jagd auf große Tiere fort.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E08 - Moose Fever
programme.desc: Chris und Kaid sind auf der Spur eines riesigen Elches, während Kaid den Schuss anvisiert. In der Zwischenzeit sind Casey und R.L. immer noch auf der Jagd nach großem Wild. Die Wasserspiegel bleiben hartnäckig hoch und wild.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E10 - Lifted
programme.desc: Als ihr Abenteuer in Alaska zu Ende geht, denken Kaid und R.L. darüber nach, was im Leben wirklich zählt und was sie über das Leben entdeckt haben. Lebenslange Bindungen sind stärker als je zuvor, während sie sich darauf vorbereiten, Alaska zu verlassen.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: In abgelegenen Gebieten ist das Überleben ein tägliches Spiel. Begleiten Sie die Moderatoren Chris und Casey Keefer, die 30 Tage lang in der Wildnis überleben wollen. Jeden neuen Tag messen diese Brüder ihre Fähigkeiten als Jäger, Waldläufer und Fischer mit einer unerbittlichen Landschaft. DROPPED konfrontiert die Zuschauer mit der harten Realität, nur das essen zu können, was man erlegen kann. Ein wahrer Überlebenstest. Die Keefer-Brüder machen sich zu Fuß auf den Weg, während ihre Reise durch Alaska beginnt. Bewaffnet mit nichts als ein paar Glock 20s beginnen die Brüder sofort mit der Suche nach ihrem ersten ergiebigen Fang.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Die Keefer-Brüder erwachen in einer gefrorenen Tundra. Ohne Paddel müssen die Brüder über mehr als 8 Meilen durch flaches Wasser und karge Erde stapfen, während sie flussabwärts nach ihrem zweiten Versteck suchen.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: Manchmal braucht es nur eine Verschiebung unter.... Desperate Hours befasst sich mit großen geologischen Katastrophen wie Lawinenabgängen in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Nepal, Peru und Frankreich. Außerdem geht es um geologische Erdrutsche auf den Philippinen, in Indien und Kolumbien sowie um ein riesiges Erdloch, das einen Teich in Bosnien verschlang. Außerdem geht es um Blizzards in den Vereinigten Staaten, Israel und dem Vereinigten Königreich.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Wenn Menschen eine ernste Gefahr für sich selbst sind ... Desperate Hours befasst sich mit Nuklear- und Industriekatastrophen, darunter die Katastrophe im japanischen Kernkraftwerk Fukushima, die Katastrophe im ukrainischen Kernkraftwerk Tschernobyl, die Ölkatastrophe im Golf von Mexiko, die Savar Plaza-Katastrophe in Bangladesch und die Bhopal-Gaskatastrophe in Indien. Wenn ein Atomkraftwerk von einer Katastrophe heimgesucht wird, kann die daraus resultierende Katastrophe im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes unvorstellbar sein und Jahrzehnte andauern.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: Die Seefahrt ist in der Tat ein gefährliches Geschäft...... Desperate Hours befasst sich mit großen Katastrophen auf hoher See, darunter das Sewol-Fährenunglück in Südkorea, die Fähre Estonia in der Ostsee, der Untergang der Titanic, die Exxon Valdez im Prince William Sound in Alaska, die Express Samina in Portes Islets, Piratenangriffe auf die Maersk Alabama und die Seabourn Spirit sowie die Costa Concordia im Mittelmeer.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Flugzeugabstürze sind für die meisten Menschen der schlimmste Albtraum. Desperate Hours befasst sich mit den großen Katastrophen der Luftfahrtgeschichte, darunter Malaysia Airlines MH17 und MH370, Air France Flug 447, Germanwings Flug 9525, die Flughafenkatastrophe auf Teneriffa, die Challenger- und Columbia-Raumfährenkatastrophen, der C-130-Absturz der indonesischen Luftwaffe 2015 auf Sumatra, der Absturz der Antonow An-124 von Irkutsk 1997 und der Absturz der Concorde Flug 4590.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Anschnallen und wachsam bleiben...... Desperate Hours befasst sich mit Straßen- und Zugunfällen, darunter das spanische Zugunglück in Santiago De Compostella, ein Straßenunfall in Pakistan, ein Unfall mit einem Öltransporter in Nigeria, bei dem 96 Menschen ums Leben kamen, das Zugunglück der Queen of the Sea in Sri Lanka, Unfälle durch Nebel in Italien und im Vereinigten Königreich, ein Unfall mit hundert Fahrzeugen auf der Autobahn A1 in Österreich, ein Straßenunfall in Mexiko und ein Amtrak-Unfall in den Vereinigten Staaten.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy bleibt im Camp Hell Hole stecken, pflegt 7's Bein und kämpft um das Überleben in den eisigen Temperaturen ohne Nahrung.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy und Seven verlassen das Lager Hell Hole und begeben sich wieder auf den Weg. Sie sind auf dem Weg in niedrigere Lagen, um einen dauerhafteren Ort zu finden, den sie ihr Zuhause nennen können.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E07 - Permanent Residence
programme.desc: Laramy und Seven finden einen langfristigen Campingplatz abseits des Schnees und auf niedrigerer Höhe. Laramy macht sich daran, einen dauerhafteren Unterschlupf zu bauen und nach Nahrung zu suchen.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy findet einige Weißwedelhirsche und konzentriert seine Bemühungen darauf, sie zu jagen.

Kaiba believes this to be a mere illusion, but Yugi knows that it is a vision of the past. The duel continues with Kaiba and Yugi attacking with their signature cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba gains a lead in the duel when he summons three Blue Eyes White Dragons. Yugi's hopes of winning come to an end, but receives some encouragement from Joey and stays strong in the game. Meanwhile, Joey's dreams and the ongoing duel cause Joey to awake.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba's final move forces the duelists to use only three cards, forcing to use the best cards in the decks to win the duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba's constant ridicule, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey manages to gain one of Kaiba's strongest cards to help him advance in the duel. Meanwhile, Téa – possessed by the good half of Marik's soul – fights Yami Marik for control of the Millennium Rod.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After defeating Joey and taking third place in the tournament, Kaiba plans to destroy the Duel Tower and bury his past forever. Ishizu and Mokuba convince him otherwise, and he gives Yugi one all-powerful card that could give him a chance to defeat Marik in the final duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul. Then, Odion arrives (although he is still weak), and tells Yami Marik that he has come to release his master (the good Marik), although Yami Marik counters this by saying that Marik's good half is almost completely gone, and that he is here to stay.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control over Marik's body, and refuses to be defeated. However, Marik's good half stalls Yami Marik long enough for Yugi to activate his spell card. Yugi's Ragnarok spell succeeds in destroying (and removing to the graveyard) Ra, allowing the good Marik to regain control of his body. However, a sliver of Yami Marik reappears on the field, although this time, he is the victim. Yami Marik tries to convince the good Marik to help him seize the Millennium Items and rule the world together, but fails as Marik has decided to stop being evil and make up for his actions. Marik surrenders the duel to Yugi, which sends Yami Marik to the Shadow Realm, ending the Battle City finals. Bakura and Mai are returned from the shadow realm and Marik is reunited with his siblings, who forgive him. Yugi receives the three Egyptian God Cards. Kaiba then activates the Duel Tower's self-destruct sequence, giving everybody one hour to get off the island before it explodes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.
